snippet.title: Words of Yendor – Video Game Trailer
snippet.description:
A procedurally generated word puzzle adventure set in a steamgoth world of amalgamated steam-age technology and antediluvian sorcery. Collect resources, solve dangerous situations and prepare for a showdown with each Master Villain to discover the meaning behind the Word of Yendor!

Free demo available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2156830/Words_of_Yendor/

Music used in this trailer is from Pixabay: https://pixabay.com/hu/music/148328

The game's official home page: https://sandorhq.com/games/words-of-yendor/
